plugin.name: Install the skip plugin
plugin.description:
Adds "Zenderal - Skip To Taming The Waves.esp".
Start a new game and you will get character creation as normal, then begin in Ark with the main quest advanced to the end of "Taming the Waves" (MQ04).
MQ01 "A New Beginning", MQ02 "The Void", MQ03 "The First Steps" and MQ04 "Taming the Waves" are completed in order, so Enderal's own quest scripts hand out their EP, gold and teleport scrolls. The prologue's Arcane Fever is cleared, exactly as Lishari's ritual would.
The MQ02 dream normally decides your class, so the mod asks instead - Warrior, Mage or Rogue - and gives you that class's starting skillbooks.
DO NOT INSTALL ALONGSIDE "Skip Intro SE". Both mods repoint Enderal's game-start marker and place their own start trigger. This mod replaces it - disable Skip Intro SE first.
Existing saves are unaffected: the trigger checks that the main quest has not started and deletes itself either way.
